messages:
priya: Heads-up: fncall rejects spiking on route=canary-intl, mostly invoice_tool. console shows sudden jump ~8m ago. Anyone owning validation?

anya: grabbing samples now. Can you paste one?

kevin: here's one raw from logs: ```{"tool":"invoice_tool","raw":"{\"invoice\":{\"id\":555,\"amount\":12.5}}"}``` Validator expected invoice.id and amount as strings with currency.

priya: so nested JSON encoded as string + numeric types. This smells like model variant tokenization differences. Canary is on model=v3-small-quant.

anya: Quick mitigation options: 1) reparsing nested JSON-in-strings up to depth=2 before schema validation (feature-flagged for canary routes); 2) soft-coercion number->string for id/amount in soft-validate mode; 3) emit metrics when we reparsed or coerced so console can split the graph into rejects / reparsed_pass / coerced_pass.

observability-bot: current validation_sample_rate=0.01. I can bump to 0.1 for route=canary-intl for 30m and create a short-lived alert at >30 rejects/min.

kevin: I can ship a small reparsing PR behind a canary flag. Will also log the original raw payload to sample store (redacting PII) when reparsing occurs.

priya: console-product: can we get a stacked chart showing rejects vs reparsed_pass vs coerced_pass and include model_variant as a filter? Right now we only show rejects which hides recoverable fixes.

console-product: yes we can add that. Will prioritize a small change to add reparsed/coerced series and a model_variant filter. Need metric names from you.

anya: metric names proposed: fncall_rejects, fncall_reparsed_fix, fncall_coerced_fix. Include labels {route, model_variant}.

observability-bot: Alert created: canary_intl_fncall_rejects_1747300000 (>30/min). Sample rate adjusted to 10% for matching routes for 30 minutes.

kevin: PR opened: reparsing logic feature-flagged as `reparse_nested_fncall_strings`; emits fncall_reparsed_fix when successful and pushes raw_sample to sample_store. Will gate rollout to routes matching canary-*.

priya: great. anya, can you add soft-coercion for id/amount as a follow-up patch? Make it opt-in and ensure coerced passes still count as a traceable event.

anya: yes will add a soft-coercion flag and emit fncall_coerced_fix. Also ensure both reparsed and coerced events include original raw payload link.

priya: owners: kevin (reparse PR), anya (coercion), observability (alert + sample rate), console-product (dashboard). Aim: mitigations live in 60 minutes. If rejects stay high we rollback the model variant.

console-product: noted. We'll add stacked view and model_variant filter; will surface links to samples in the chart tooltip.

priya: thanks. Please post status when deployments are live.
